summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its annual report on the Brazilian Code of Corporate Governance as of July 31, 2026. The document discusses standard governance practices, including shareholding structure (only common shares), voting agreements, and defensive measures. There are no transactions, offers, or special situations. It is a routine compliance disclosure for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a governance report, not a current report announcing a deal or corporate action.
